extracted.exercise: 14 to 16 November 2023; "more than 1,000 participants", "over 170 financial institutions across more than 20 countries"
outcome_facts: Findings rest on anonymous in-exercise polling: "During the simulation, participants were polled on a series of questions ... These key findings form the basis of this after-action report"

"Ninety-eight percent of firms have developed and maintain response and recovery plans for their critical third parties, and 80% of firms state their plans can account for outages lasting 24 hours or more"
"Information sharing is widespread and involves senior leadership and the board level"
"Participants report their response and recovery plans for the loss of critical third-party services meet well-established industry standards"
"Quantum Dawn VII demonstrated the industry's preparations for an incident effecting a critical third party"
